articles.author: Dexter Honorio
articles.description:
While watching a LIVE 24/7: High School Musical 1 on YouTube this morning, I realized…
“Stick to the Status Quo” is basically the unofficial anthem of everyone telling founders what NOT to do. It low-key feels like a startup founder experience in the Philippines.
Everyone’s basically saying:
“Ganito na yan.”

But… startups literally exist because someone didn’t follow that advice.
A lot of Filipino founders don’t fit one box — and that’s the point. Tech founders who care about community impact. Creatives building real businesses. Innovators solving very local problems with very new ideas. The ecosystem doesn’t always know what to do with that, so there’s pushback.
Breaking from the norm is uncomfortable — especially when resources are tight and the risk feels personal. But every meaningful startup in the PH started with someone asking, “What if we try something different?”
So no, founders don’t stick to the status quo.
question it. We remix it. We build anyway.
And sometimes, that’s how real change starts — when we get’cha head in the game.  twinks
articles.title: Stick to the Status Quo

articles.author: Jervi
articles.description:
If you’re running a Hackintosh using HDMI audio, you might’ve hit a super annoying issue:
👉 Audio is always at 100% and can’t be controlled
Source Jervi-writes article
All of classic Hackintosh stuff:
Tweaking EFI / OpenCore

Audio layout changes
Patching AppleHDA
Different framebuffer configs
Nothing worked. HDMI audio volume stayed locked at max.
Turns out the fix wasn’t in EFI at all.
MonitorControl (yes, the app used for external display brightness) completely solved the issue.
Once installed:
HDMI audio volume became adjustable
Keyboard volume keys worked
macOS volume slider finally did something
No EFI changes needed
HDMI audio is tied to the display, and macOS treats it differently than normal audio outputs.
MonitorControl hooks into display-level controls, which indirectly restores proper volume handling for HDMI audio on RX480.
articles.title: Fixing HDMI Audio Stuck at 100% on Hackintosh

Honestly, the biggest win for me wasn't just the new portfolio—it was the inspiration. Participating in this challenge and exploring Google's AI ecosystem actually sparked the idea for my latest project, "My Baby Name".
